responsibility: Generates the powerpcspe-tables.opt option table from the CPU list in powerpcspe-cpus.def. The script emits the common Enum boilerplate for rs6000_cpu_opt_value, inserts the special native entry, then uses awk to enumerate each RS6000_CPU definition into an EnumValue record, automating the option-table data consumed by GCC’s option generator for -mcpu=/ -mtune= names.
